parts.name: Left finger — Generalist yellow, mirror of the right
Right finger — Generalist yellow
Left handle-gear — black, the left handle: one print with its gear (both hooks, two strap-loop slots, tail fused into the hub), turns on the base’s left post
Right handle-gear — black, the right handle: one print with its gear (both hooks, two strap-loop slots, tail fused into the hub), driven by the pinion, turns on the right post
Pinion — black, centred, full-height teeth, 3 countersunk M3 to the motor flange
Base — black flat plate with a pivot post for each handle-gear, 3 countersunk M3 to the motor
Top plate — black, over the handle-gears and fingers on 3 pillars; a C-shaped ring round each pivot runs in its handle-gear’s groove, so each axle is held top and bottom
Wrist bracket — black L: its leg bolts to the RS00’s back face (4 M3), its foot lies across the arm’s J6 axis and takes the tool plate; a zip-tie point for the motor’s cable
Tool plate — the gripper’s side of the wrist interface (twin of Seeed’s Connector B): 4 M3 up into the bracket, slips over the hub, 3 radial M3
Wrist hub — stays on the arm: bolted to J6’s RS00 output (twin of Seeed’s Connector A; Seeed’s aluminium one fits too)
Aero Hand tool plate — the same tool plate plus an 8 mm spacer with a cable channel: 4 M3 straight into the Aero Hand’s wrist inserts
Motor — RobStride RS00, reference only (not printed)
Aero Hand (left) palm — reference: TetherIA’s CAD (third_party/aero_hand, guide meshes), standing on its tool plate beside the arm
Aero Hand (left) thumb — reference: CMC block, MCP, proximal, distal and tip links, posed by aero_thumb_abd_deg, aero_thumb_flex_deg, aero_curl_deg
Aero Hand (left) index finger — reference: proximal, middle, distal and tip links, posed by aero_curl_deg
Aero Hand (left) middle finger — reference: proximal, middle, distal and tip links, posed by aero_curl_deg
Aero Hand (left) ring finger — reference: proximal, middle, distal and tip links, posed by aero_curl_deg
Aero Hand (left) pinky — reference: proximal, middle, distal and tip links, posed by aero_curl_deg
